newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rates up on U.S. long bond, weak peso.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rates up on U.S. long bond, weak peso.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates were up 65 basis points to 17.75 percent in early trade on Tuesday under pressure from high U.S. long bond rates and a soft peso, traders said.
"You can feel the market is under pressure from the levels at which the (U.S.) long bond is trading," a trader said.
U.S. 30-year Treasury bonds were meanwhile off 16/32 to yield 7.03 percent.
The benchmark 48-hour peso was 1.2 centavos weaker in early trade at 7.9230/7.9280 per dollar.
